method.label: Time each part of a lap

annotationRationale: The method applies the distance-speed-time relationship to each segment, then converts the total from seconds to minutes and seconds.
sourceMethod: Followed the official calculation of time per lap, multiplication by five, and conversion to minutes and seconds.

review.mathCheck: Each lap takes 100/4 + 300/5 = 85 seconds. Five laps take 425 seconds, or 7 minutes 5 seconds. Segment times are correctly added rather than averaging the two speeds. Answer C is correct.
review.sourceMethodCheck: Faithful, originally worded adaptation of attached MAA solution 2, with the same segment-time calculation and an explicit time conversion.
review.annotationCheck: The quantitative-relationship node fits solving distance = speed × time for time. Time-unit conversion is appropriate supporting knowledge. The explanation is complete for AMC 10.
